purpose: Static single-page visual art as PNG or PDF: a design-philosophy movement expressed visually with minimal text.
use_when: Creating a static poster, artwork, or single-page design as PNG or PDF from a design-philosophy movement
Expressing an aesthetic movement visually on a canvas with minimal text as visual accent
Producing a museum-quality art object with spatial composition, color zones, and refined typography
do_not_use_when: Designing a new landing page or app UI with visual identity and layout (use anthropic__frontend-design)
Building an interactive claude.ai HTML artifact with React and bundling scripts (use anthropic__web-artifacts-builder)
Generating code-driven generative art with p5.js seeded randomness (use anthropic__algorithmic-art)
scope: Only touch files the task names; everything else read-only.
disambiguator: Making static PNG/PDF art objects from a design philosophy -> this. Designing interactive UI or websites -> anthropic__frontend-design. Building bundled HTML artifacts -> anthropic__web-artifacts-builder.
